title: 'Heads should roll': Ruhullah slams govt over JKSSB scam

ai.summary: Former MP Aga Ruhullah Mehdi criticized both Jammu and Kashmir administrations for alleged JKSSB exam scam, demanding accountability and punishment for those responsible to prevent student injustice.

facts.claim: Former MP and National Conference leader Aga Ruhullah Mehdi launched a scathing attack on both administrations over the alleged JKSSB paper leak and cheating scam
facts.quote: Srinagar, Nov 21: Former MP and National Conference leader Aga Ruhullah Mehdi on Saturday launched a scathing attack on both the administrations over the alleged JKSSB paper leak and cheating scam, saying the system has been compromised and injustice is being done to generations of students.

facts.claim: Ruhullah said technology is being used in cheating and instead of providing a level playing field, the system is working against the students
facts.quote: Speaking to reporters during the students’ protest, Ruhullah said technology is being used in cheating and instead of providing a level playing field, the system is working against the students.

facts.claim: Students have repeatedly spoken about this. For three-four years continuously, a scam has been surfacing in one form or another. One year in one form, the next year in another form. No serious effort is being made anywhere to stop it
facts.quote: Students have repeatedly spoken about this. For three-four years continuously, a scam has been surfacing in one form or another. One year in one form, the next year in another form. No serious effort is being made anywhere to stop it,

facts.claim: Ruhullah demanded fixing of responsibility and punishment for those accountable
facts.quote: He demanded fixing of responsibility and punishment for those accountable.

facts.claim: Ruhullah said both administrations are responsible — the unelected administration has built the system since 2019 as a result of which these scams are happening again and again, and the elected administration was voted in 2024 to bring reforms and make corrections
facts.quote: Ruhullah said both administrations are responsible — the unelected administration has built the system since 2019 as a result of which these scams are happening again and again, and the elected administration was voted in 2024 to bring reforms and make corrections.

ai.background_note: The JKSSB (Jammu and Kashmir State Service Board) exam scam allegations have been a recurring issue in Jammu and Kashmir, with students protesting for years over alleged cheating and irregularities in the examination system.
